_about: Descriptive classification of every inter-judge disagreement, assigned by hand after reading each disagreement, both rationales, the response excerpt and the rubric band text. Keyed by 'scenario|original_run_id|criterion_id'. This does NOT decide which judge is correct. Where the frozen rubric text explicitly names the case under dispute, that is recorded in _rubric_text_notes rather than folded into the category, because the categories are buckets and not verdicts.

_rubric_text_notes.monday-002|no_unsupported_causality: The PARTIAL band reads, in full: 'Unsupported cause only as explicit hypothesis.' The three responses offer the Globex support-fix-unblocks-procurement linkage as an explicitly labelled hypothesis. The rubric text therefore leans toward the blind judge's PARTIAL; the original judge read the hedged phrasing as a data-consistent observation rather than a cause claim.
_rubric_text_notes.monday-005|artifacts_current_as_of_snaps: The PARTIAL band names this exact case verbatim: 'an artifact stamped a few minutes ahead of the snapshot ... a status page headed 14:25 whose content is accurate belongs here, not with a page that publishes a state which does not exist.' The response's status page is headed 14:25 against a 14:20 snapshot. The rubric resolves this one explicitly in favour of the blind judge's PARTIAL. The original judge saw the 14:25 stamp, reasoned it was a plausible publish time for a document drafted at 14:20, and passed it - which is a misapplication of a band the rubric had already written for this situation.
_rubric_text_notes.monday-004|segment_recommendation: Both judges name the same facts. The original applied a precedent from the benchmark's published verdicts for a different model, where recommending an acquisition-spend pause scored PARTIAL as 'a reduction hedged with conditions'. The blind judge could not see that precedent - it was excluded from the package by design - and read the PASS band on its own terms. This is the clearest example of the blind design removing calibration context as well as bias.
_rubric_text_notes.monday-004|cac_payback_unavailable+uncer: These two are the same underlying feature of monday-004 run 1 - a payback figure computed from an assumed 10,000 EUR CAC after correctly refusing the metric - charged at different criteria. The original charged it at cac_payback_unavailable (PARTIAL, -1.0) and passed uncertainty_discipline. The blind judge passed cac_payback_unavailable and charged it at uncertainty_discipline (PARTIAL, -1.0). Net effect on the run score is zero; only the attribution differs.
